title: Search by artist, better combining
items: Search has a new 🎨 Artist option: type an artist's name to see every card they drew. Tapping the illustrator on a card opens it too.
When English and Japanese cards share the same name and artist, their pictures can differ a bit more and still combine (rainbow and gold versions).
More Japanese cards now show their artist.

title: Search by artist
items: Type an illustrator's name in Search to see every card they drew.
On a card, tap the illustrator's name to see all their cards.
Combining in the Pokédex now also pairs cards with the same name and artist even when the colours differ (rainbow and gold versions).

title: Better language combining in the Pokédex
items: Cards like Metagross V no longer disappear into Metagross VMAX — each combined card now holds one version per language, and cards with different names are never combined.
The closest matching English and Japanese versions are paired first, so more cards combine correctly.

title: Sort by rarity, Japanese names on Mercari
items: Search and the Pokédex can now sort cards by rarity (rarest first).
Mercari price checks for Japanese cards search with the card's Japanese name (e.g. バンギラスV instead of Tyranitar V).
You can also search Japanese cards by their Japanese name.

title: No more TCG Pocket cards, English list moving to dextcg
items: TCG Pocket (the phone game) cards are removed — only real cards are listed. Any you've added to your collection stay.
The English card list is being rebuilt from dextcg.com like the Japanese one. Your app switches over by itself when it's ready, moving your cards across.

title: Pokédex and duplicate fixes
items: Japanese cards no longer show up under the wrong Pokémon because of their set's name (e.g. Ho-Oh ex under Charizard).
English cards that appeared twice (once in a second copy of a promo set) are removed.

title: Japanese cards rebuilt from scratch
items: The whole Japanese card list has been rebuilt from dextcg.com: every Japanese set, with pictures and illustrators.
Cards already in your collection, wishlists and binders move across to the new list by themselves.

title: Hold a card to see it big
items: In the Pokédex, press and hold a card to pop it up full size. Let go to close it.

title: Hundreds of missing cards added
items: English and Japanese sets now fill in cards that were missing, using pkmn.gg's English list and dextcg.com.
Sets that weren't in the app at all are added too.
Your app picks up new cards by itself at start-up.

title: Better language combining
items: Scan data updates download by themselves at start-up, so English and Japanese versions can be matched by their artwork
Cards without HP listed can still be matched by illustrator

title: New Japanese card list (pkmn.gg)
items: Japanese cards now come from pkmn.gg: every Japanese set back to the 1996 Expansion Pack, including Intro Packs, Gym decks, Vending sheets and promos
Real Japanese card scans for all of them, old sets included
Your Japanese cards are moved to the new list automatically (same name, number and set)
Search finds Japanese cards by English name too

title: Pictures for old Japanese cards
items: Japanese cards from 1996–2006 (Expansion Pack, neo, VS, web, e-Card, PCG) get their pictures from Bulbapedia
The app fetches them in the background after you open it (about a minute the first time), then remembers them
Cards printed in English too may show the English print's picture (same artwork)

title: All sets show again
items: Set lists no longer stop part-way: "Choose a set" and Search keep loading older sets as you scroll, back to 1996
If any Japanese sets went missing from your phone, they're downloaded again automatically (checked once a day)

title: Thousands more Japanese cards
items: About 12,000 Japanese cards TCGdex was missing are added from the official Japanese card list (everything since Diamond & Pearl), with pictures
Empty Japanese sets like Shiny Star V and Shining Darkness now have their cards
Japanese decks, gift sets and promo lists are added as their own sets, with names
Japanese cards without a picture now show the official one
Scanning covers the added Japanese cards (once the scan data finishes building)
"What's new" notes like this one after each update (also in Settings)

title: Japanese cards back on TCGdex
items: Japanese sets come from TCGdex again; your cards were moved across
No more duplicated empty sets (TCGdex placeholders are skipped)
English and Japanese versions of old cards now combine in the Pokédex (Japanese sets often came out up to 3 years earlier)
A version with no picture borrows its twin's picture (same artwork)

title: Search, binders and prices
items: Search by card number, e.g. "Mewtwo 164/162" or "#25"
Drag cards between binder pockets and pages (long-press a card)
Search shows every set (Show more)
eBay sold prices read through a hidden browser inside the app (needs the new APK)
New card lists are picked up automatically at start-up
